description:
Goal
Make TransportShape(position) depend on TransportComponent(position) instead of rebuilding a component projection itself. The component product must start from one demanded anchor and follow only reachable equality/source edges for that component.

Signal
TransportShape(position) first waits for ProductKey::TransportComponent(position), then reads the produced shape for that position. TransportComponent telemetry reports the component size and demanded anchor. It does not expand to every executable known to a root/session just to find supply. 00181 still produces the tuple integer return shape and direct Kernel.+/2 callable facts.

Strategy
Separate three responsibilities: local edge emission for one executable/position, component reachability from an anchor, and final shape lookup. Use structural descriptors for decisions; sorting is allowed only for deterministic output after membership is known.

Removal steps
- Delete project_transport_component_product as the catch-all producer once its pieces are split. Do not leave it unused “for reference.”
- Remove the TransportShape path that calls the catch-all projection directly. Missing component data must wait on ProductKey::TransportComponent(position).
- Remove side-effect recording of unrelated shapes/callables/boundaries from a TransportShape request. Those must be produced by their own products or by the demanded component product.
- Delete compatibility branches that expand from session.demanded_executables just to build a larger shape graph.

Verification
Component-size telemetry test; insertion-order stability test; 00181 product-path transport assertion; rg proving TransportShape no longer calls the catch-all projection directly.
title: Pull transport: split TransportShape from demanded component solving
